[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). For d≥1, the note proves an intrinsic minimax lower benchmark but only observable upper rates that are polynomially slower throughout the nontrivial quadratic zone, so it does not determine the conditional minimax frontier. The mixed spectral transition is proved only for an infeasible population-score, population-kernel statistic; neither observable quantile consistency nor an honest mixed-regime confidence procedure is delivered. The matched d=0 rate and Brownian-bridge law concern a separate no-covariate branch and are too narrow, especially given their close relation to classical quantile-process theory, to elevate the whole contribution to field tier. The framing consistently describes the d≥1 result as a bracket and the calibration as open, so there is no stale claim of a matched rate or completed observable inference.

DIRECTED IMPROVEMENT (re-derive the SAME object implementing this, do not reproduce the prior note): Turn the population Gaussian–quadratic proxy into the specified observable common-multiplier interval and prove uniform coverage across equality, local, critical, and regular regimes, including corrected resolutions where full covariance estimation is infeasible.
